```python
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
MODEL = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
tools = [{"name": "get_weather", "description": "Get the weather", "input_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["city"]}}]
msg = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=512, tools=tools, messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Weather in Oakland?"}])
for block in msg.content:
    if block.type == "tool_use":
        print("Claude asked for", block.input)
        result = {"type": "tool_result", "tool_use_id": block.id, "content": "Sunny, 18 C"}
```

```python
import anthropic

client = anthropic.Anthropic()
MODEL = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
history = [{"role": "user", "content": "Name a color."}]
first = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=64, messages=history)
history.append({"role": "assistant", "content": first.content[0].text})
history.append({"role": "user", "content": "Name another."})
second = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=64, messages=history)
print(second.content[0].text)
```

```python
client = anthropic.Anthropic()
MODEL = "claude-sonnet-5-5"
long_prompt = "You are a helpful assistant. " * 500
msg = client.messages.create(model=MODEL, max_tokens=256, system=[{"type": "text", "text": long_prompt, "cache_control": {"type": "ephemeral"}}], messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hi"}])
```
